items.source: Thread-safety note: a narrow write-after-close race exists when clearIndex(String) is called concurrently for the same session from a different thread. The advisor's built-in flow prevents this via the atomic fingerprint-check in initializeSession(). Direct callers must ensure that no concurrent clearIndex() runs for the same session; if one does, the document is silently dropped (the session was cleared anyway).
items.translation: 线程安全说明： 当从不同线程并发调用clearIndex(String)以处理同一会话时，存在一个窄范围的关闭后写竞争。顾问的内置流程通过initializeSession()中的原子指纹检查来防止此问题。直接调用者必须确保不会针对同一会话并发运行多个clearIndex()；如果确实发生了这种情况，文档将被静默丢弃（因为会话无论如何都会被清除）。

items.source: Implementations should override this method when a batch operation is more efficient than repeated ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference) calls (e.g. a single embedding API call or a single write transaction). The default implementation simply iterates and delegates to ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference).
items.translation: 实现类应在批量操作比重复调用ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference)更高效时（例如单次嵌入 API 调用或单次写入事务）重写此方法。默认实现仅迭代并委托给ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference)。

items.source:
This class provides full-text search capabilities for tool metadata using Apache
Lucene's in-memory index. Entries are grouped by sessionId and retrieval is filtered by
the provided sessionId.
items.translation: 该类利用 Apache Lucene 的内存索引为工具元数据提供全文搜索功能。条目按会话 ID（sessionId）进行分组，检索结果将根据提供的会话 ID 进行过滤。
